caveats.statement: tb020的LoanStatus(cl0229)有A/B/C/D四种,统计'运行中'需明确只取C
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cl0229, COUNT(*) FROM tb020 GROUP BY cl0229

caveats.statement: tb022的Transaction Type(cl0233)有54%为空,按交易类型过滤会漏掉大量交易
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb022 WHERE cl0233 IS NULL

caveats.statement: tb035的Lap Time(cl0262)有78%为空,计算完成率时需区分空值与非空值
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb035 WHERE cl0262 IS NULL

caveats.statement: tb025的Code(cl0254)有90%为空,按车手代码查询会漏掉大部分车手
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb025 WHERE cl0254 IS NULL

caveats.statement: tb042的Club ID(cl0305)有8%为空,按俱乐部汇总资金会丢失记录
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb042 WHERE cl0305 IS NULL

caveats.statement: tb001.cl0012 Provision Type is 82% null, so filtering on a provision type silently drops most schools.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN cl0012 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nulls FROM tb001

caveats.statement: tb003.cl0061 Close Date is 68% null and cl0043 School Status includes Closed/Merged, so 'active school' counts must filter status, not just null close date.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cl0043, COUNT(*) FROM tb003 GROUP BY cl0043

caveats.statement: tb004 has 56822 rows but only 20000 distinct Card IDs, so counting rows overcounts cards; use COUNT(DISTINCT cl0089).
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows, COUNT(DISTINCT cl0089) AS cards FROM tb004

caveats.statement: tb004.cl0143 Power is text and 55% null; non-creature cards store '*' or NULL, so numeric comparisons need casting and null handling.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cl0143, COUNT(*) FROM tb004 GROUP BY cl0143 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

caveats.statement: tb006 has 427907 rows across 15 formats and 3 legality statuses; a card can be Legal in one format and Banned in another, so always filter cl0164.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cl0164, cl0165, COUNT(*) FROM tb006 GROUP BY cl0164, cl0165 ORDER BY 1,2

caveats.statement: tb005 and tb008 store localized card names/types, so joining them to tb004 on name or type fails; join on Card ID / Set Code instead.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb005 WHERE cl0137 NOT IN (SELECT cl0137 FROM tb004)

caveats.statement: tb014.cl0198 Average Monthly Balance can be negative (min -5194.88), so averages and 'lowest balance' queries must not assume positive values.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb014 WHERE cl0198 < 0

caveats.statement: tb020.cl0227 Loan Validity has only 5 values (12..60); 'more than 12 months' excludes the most common 12-month loans.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cl0227, COUNT(*) FROM tb020 GROUP BY cl0227 ORDER BY 1

caveats.statement: tb050.cl0347 Weight uses 0 for missing data, so AVG(weight) and 'missing weight' filters must treat 0 as null.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb050 WHERE cl0347 = 0

caveats.statement: tb054 coagulation columns cl0361/cl0362/cl0363 are separate '+'/'-' flags; 'positive degree of coagulation' must OR across all three, not just cl0362.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN cl0361 = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c1, SUM(CASE WHEN cl0362 = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c2, SUM(CASE WHEN cl0363 = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c3 FROM tb054

caveats.statement: 患者性别、住院状态等属性在tb055中,而症状、抗体检测在tb054中,需按患者ID关联,直接跨表计数会重复或遗漏
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb055 p LEFT JOIN tb054 d ON p.cl0353 = d.cl0353 WHERE d.cl0353 IS NULL

caveats.statement: 症状字段cl0364大量为空,空值表示无症状,用COUNT(*)会把无症状患者算进去,应使用COUNT(DISTINCT cl0353) WHERE cl0364 IS NOT NULL
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(cl0364) AS non_null FROM tb054

caveats.statement: IgG正常范围需同时满足>900和<2000,只写一个边界会包含异常值
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb056 WHERE cl0398 <= 900 OR cl0398 >= 2000

caveats.statement: 年龄需由出生日期cl0367计算,直接对日期求平均会得到无意义结果
caveats.check_sql: SELECT MIN(cl0367), MAX(cl0367) FROM tb055
